title: Add ESLint + Prettier for code quality
description: Set up ESLint with Vue 3 + TypeScript rules and Prettier for formatting. Add lint/format npm scripts.
close_reason: ESLint 9 (flat config) + Vue 3 + TypeScript + Prettier configured. Scripts: lint, lint:fix, format, format:check. Quality gate added to AGENTS.md.

title: Design and document component customization patterns
description: Document the patterns for wrapping Quasar components: prop forwarding, slot passthrough, style overrides, theme tokens. Create a CONTRIBUTING.md with guidelines for adding new components.

title: Configure npm/GitHub Packages publishing
description: Set up package publishing workflow: configure .npmrc, add prepublishOnly script, set up GitHub Actions for CI/CD to publish to npm or GitHub Packages on tag/release.

title: Plan initial component set to customize
description: Identify which Quasar components need Nonsuch customization first. Create issues for each. Potential candidates: form inputs (NsInput, NsSelect), layout (NsCard, NsDialog), data (NsTable).

title: Create shared theme/design tokens
description: Define shared Sass variables/tokens (colors, spacing, typography, border-radius) for Nonsuch theme. These override or extend Quasar's default Sass variables and provide a consistent design language.

title: Deploy Storybook to static hosting
description: Deploy Storybook to a static hosting service (GitHub Pages, Netlify, or Vercel) so the component library has a live documentation site. Set up automated deployment via CI.

title: Add CI pipeline (GitHub Actions)
description: Create GitHub Actions workflow for: pnpm install, type-check, lint, test, build. Run on push/PR to main.
